---
title: "Read Distribution"
output: html_document
---

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(gt)
library(here)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Read distribution of the PacBio raw reads

```{r echo=FALSE}
files <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/GSL_Data/length/raw',
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.tsv.gz')
df <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  data <- fread(file, nThread = 20)
  colnames(data) <- c('id', 'length')
  data <- data %>% mutate(file = str_remove(basename(file), '.tsv.gz'))
})

ggplot(df) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = length), binwidth = 1000) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  facet_wrap(~file, ncol = 1, scales = 'free')
```

Summary statistics

```{r echo=FALSE}
df %>%
  group_by(file) %>% 
  summarise(min = min(length),
            median = median(length),
            mean = mean(length),
            sd = sd(length),
            max = max(length)) %>% 
  gt %>% fmt_auto()
```
